### workspace stop --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace stop [--name WS | --all] [--json] [project1] [project2] ...

Stop workspace projects and their tmux sessions.
With no project, stops the workspace the current directory is in; --all stops
every active workspace project. Outside any workspace, name one or pass --all.
Projects can be restarted with 'workspace launch'.

        --name NAME                  A workspace to stop, added to any named positionally (default: the one detected from the current directory)
        --all                        Stop every active workspace project
        --json                       Print one action document (see docs/README.json.md) instead of text, which goes
                                     to stderr; a named project that isn't active gets a not_running row, not a warning

Examples:
  workspace stop    # stop the workspace you are in
  workspace stop --all    # stop every active project
  workspace stop my-notes    # stop one project
  workspace stop my-notes billing    # stop several projects
--- stderr
--- end
